name: Iconflow
description: Icon sets and hover motion for Zen. Circuit, a set of glass and neon icons that animate on hover; Zen's own icons animated; menu icon animation; motion for close, plus, minus and other buttons; Library button icons; and new tab button options (takes over Better New Tab button).
author: Dragon74X

sine-update-guard.sys.mjs.name: Sine Update Guard
sine-update-guard.sys.mjs.description: Serialize installs/updates and wait for replacement files before reading preferences.

iconflow.uc.js.name: Iconflow
iconflow.uc.js.description: Writes Iconflow's preference variables and defaults.

iconflow-parts.uc.js.name: Iconflow parts
iconflow-parts.uc.js.description: Animates Zen's own icons (or New Icons') part by part, from the artwork each button already shows.
